source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Being considered the single most accurate temperature route in every situation, without regard for individual client factors","B":"Carrying essentially no limitations at all across every possible clinical situation compared with other temperature routes","C":"Can be affected by recent oral intake of hot or cold substances, requiring a waiting period before accurate measurement","D":"Being considered inappropriate for use in essentially any clinical situation a nurse might encounter"}}
source_row.rationale: Oral temperature measurement can be affected by recent oral intake of hot or cold substances, requiring a waiting period (commonly around 15-30 minutes) before accurate measurement, an important consideration for accurate temperature assessment.
source_row.source_name: Standard Nursing Fundamentals — Temperature Measurement Accuracy
